ns2:course.label: Algebraic Number Theory
ns2:course.description: Further development of the theory of fields covering topics from valuation theory, ideal theory, units in algebraic number fields, ramification, function fields, and local class field theory. Prerequisite: MATH 500 or equivalent.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Not intended for Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign. Not intended for MS:Economics:Policy Econ -UIUC, MS:Economics:Policy Econ -UIUC, or MS: Financial Engineering.
